jobs.title: Head of Sales (w/m/d) Digital & Automation (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Head of Sales (w/m/d) Digital & Automation, um die Vertriebsorganisation innerhalb unserer Business Line Digital & Automation effizient zu steuern und profitables Wachstum nachhaltig voranzutreiben.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Stelle ist für Jobsharing geeignet. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Tandems. Bei Interesse bitten wir um gemeinsame Bewerbung beider Tandempartner*innen.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie führen und entwickeln ein Team aus Business Managerinnen, Sales Enablement Managerinnen und Customer Visit Manager*innen mit Fokus auf Wachstum und operative Exzellenz.- Sie stellen die Erreichung der Geschäftsziele sicher und gestalten gemeinsam mit den Zonen zukunftsweisende Vertriebsstrategien.- Sie treiben die Definition und Umsetzung strategischer Vertriebsinitiativen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Business Development sowie relevanten Schnittstellen voran.- Sie steuern operative Themen wie Preisstrategien, Eskalationsmanagement und wertorientierte Geschäftsentwicklung innerhalb der Vertriebsorganisation, um einen profitables Geschäftsmodell sicherzustellen.- Sie erstellen und steuern aussagekräftige Business-Reports, Forecasts, Projekt-Reviews.- Sie arbeiten eng mit diversen internen Schnittstellen zusammen, um die übergeordneten Unternehmensziele zu erreichen.- Sie verantworten die Konzeption und Umsetzung von Sales Enablement- und Trainingsformaten sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen und Mindset im Team.- Sie stellen die Einhaltung von Prozessen, Richtlinien und Governance-Vorgaben sicher und fördern gleichzeitig eine kollaborative Kultur.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Digital Solutions & Automation (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/digital-health-solutions) .

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Medizintechnik, Clinical Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.- Sie bringen langjährige, international geprägte Berufserfahrung mit und haben erfolgreich mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen, Märkten und Geschäftspraktiken in komplexen globalen Organisationen gearbeitet.- Zusätzlich überzeugen Sie durch Ihre mehrjährige Erfahrung im vertrieblichen Umfeld der MedTech-Branche, idealerweise mit starkem Bezug zu Healthcare IT, inklusive strategischer Marktentwicklung, Key Account Management sowie der erfolgreichen Positionierung innovativer Lösungen.- Sie haben internationale Teams erfolgreich geführt, weiterentwickelt und zu nachhaltigem Geschäftserfolg gesteuert. Dabei verbinden Sie ausgeprägte Leadership-Kompetenz mit einem klaren Fokus auf Performance und Wachstum.- Ihr Profil wird abgerundet durch eine hohe internationale Mobilität und Reisebereitschaft (etwa 30%).

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- In unserem internationalen Geschäftsumfeld kommunizieren Sie verhandlungssicher auf Englisch; Deutsch sowie weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.- Sie überzeugen durch ausgeprägte Führungs- und Coachingkompetenz und entwickeln Teams zielgerichtet weiter.- Sie agieren strategisch und unternehmerisch, mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu analysieren und in klare Handlungsfelder zu übersetzen.- Sie kommunizieren souverän und adressatengerecht auf allen Ebenen und fördern aktiv eine bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.- Sie bringen eine hohe Ergebnisorientierung sowie Entscheidungsstärke mit und behalten auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick.- Sie zeichnen sich durch ein starkes Stakeholder-Management und die Fähigkeit aus, unterschiedliche Interessen erfolgreich zu vereinen.- Sie leben eine kollaborative „Win Together“-Mentalität und fördern eine Kultur von Vertrauen, Engagement und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Antonia Hanke.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: (Junior) Marketing Analyst*in (m/w/d), Hartlauer Zentrale (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Absatz/Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Wirtschaft)
jobs.description: Willkommen bei Hartlauer! Bei uns zählen Qualität, Weiterbildung und Löwengeist. Das macht uns seit 1971 zu Österreichs führendem Fachberater für Optik, Hörakustik, Foto und Handy. In unserer Zentrale und den 160 Geschäften warten 1.900 Kolleg:innen auf dich. Bist du Qualitätsdenker:in, Vollblutlöw:in und Möglichmacher:in? Dann passt du perfekt ins Rudel. Deine Aufgaben Mit deinem scharfen Blick analysierst du Marketing- und Kundendaten im Salesforce CRM Analytics Tool und machst aus Zahlen wertvolle Erkenntnisse für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Mit aussagekräftigen Analysen, Reports und Auswertungen sorgst du für Transparenz in der Savanne unserer Kundendatenqualität. Aus den gewonnenen Erkenntnissen leitest du wertvolle Impulse ab - insbesondere für unsere Geschäftsbereiche Optik und Hörakustik. Du agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen verschiedenen Fachbereichen, erkennst bereichsübergreifende Zusammenhänge und bringst deine Ideen sowie Verbesserungsvorschläge proaktiv ein. Teilprojekte rund um unsere Salesforce-CRM-Prozesse führst du eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg. Mit datenbasierten Erkenntnissen entwickelst du bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass wir auch morgen den richtigen Pfad einschlagen. Dein Beitrag Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Statistik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen - oder bereits einschlägige Berufserfahrung gesammelt. Marketing- und CRM-Prozesse sind für dich kein unbekanntes Revier. Erste einschlägige Berufserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber auch motivierte Einstiegslöw:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Zahlen sind deine Stärke. Du analysierst Daten mit Neugier und Weitblick und verwandelst komplexe Zusammenhänge in wertvolle Erkenntnisse. Neben deiner Expertise in Excel und PowerPoint kannst du bereits gut mit CRM-Tools und Salesforce Apps umgehen. Kenntnisse in SQL oder einer anderen Programmiersprache sind von Vorteil. Auch große Datenmengen analysierst und strukturierst du mit Ausdauer, System und einem klaren Blick für Lösungen. So sorgst du dafür, dass aus Daten echte Entscheidungen werden. Unsere Brüller Als Vollblutlöw:in bist du von Anfang an Teil des Rudels und spürst unseren Löwengeist. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht 9 to 5 sondern ganz flexibel innerhalb eines Gleitzeitrahmens von 06:30 bis 20:00 Uhr. Wir sind Möglichmacher:innen - dich erwarten bei uns viele fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Du hast nach der Einarbeitung die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeit im Büro mit Homeoffice Tagen zu kombinieren. Unsere löwenstarken Benefits wie ein eigener Fitnessraum, ein eScooter auch zur privaten Nutzung und tägliche Vitamin- und Gebäcklieferung, genießt du ab dem Start bei uns. Deine Beute Für Einstiegslöw:innen winkt für diese Position ein Jahresgehalt ab EUR 42.000 brutto auf Vollzeit-Basis. Im persönlichen Gespräch legen wir dein Gehalt je nach konkreter Qualifikation gemeinsam fest. Spürst du den Löwengeist in dir? Dann bewirb dich!

jobs.title: Administration und Finance Manager (m/w/d) Baugewerbe (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Driving Energy Projects to Reality!

Administration und Finance Manager (m/w/d) Baugewerbe in Gramastetten

SICIM ist einer der weltweit führenden EPC-Dienstleister (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) für anspruchsvolle Energie- und Infrastrukturprojekte. Seit über 60 Jahren realisiert das Unternehmen schlüsselfertige Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Mit rund 15.000 Mitarbeitenden und einer weltweiten Präsenz steht SICIM für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer Projekte in den Bereichen Pipelinebau, Anlagenbau, Wasserstoffproduktion sowie weiterer zukunftsweisender Energietechnologien.

Zum Aufbau unseres Teams in Oberösterreich (Mühlviertel / Linz) suchen wir einen

Administration und Finance Manager (m/w/d)

Deine Aufgaben

- Verantwortung für die gesamte Projektadministration und den operativen Bürobetrieb.
- Steuerung und Koordination externer Dienstleister, wie Steuerberater, Versicherungvertretern sowie administrativer Leistungen von Nachunternehmern.
- Unterstützung der Projektleitung bei Finanzkontrolle, Kostenüberwachung und Budgetmanagement.
- Koordination der Rechnungsprüfung, Rechnungsbearbeitung und Durchführung von Zahlungsläufen, vorbereitende Buchhaltung für den Steuerberater
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher, steuerlicher und administrativer Vorgaben sowie interner Unternehmensrichtlinien.
- Unterstützung bei Budgetierungs-, Forecast- und Kostenplanungsprozessen, Erstellung von Reports
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Finanzen, Einkauf, Projektmanagement und weiteren zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen.
- Unterstützung bei Audits sowie der Dokumentation relevanter Projektprozesse.
- Sicherstellung einer effizienten Informations- und Dokumentenverwaltung innerhalb der Projektorganisation.

Dein Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung/Studium
- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Teamleiter im Bereich allgemeine Verwaltung / (Vorbereitende) Buchhaltung, gerne in Start-up-Umfeld bzw. in großen Bau-/Infrastruktur- oder EPC-Projekten
- Fundierte Kenntnisse österreichischer Verwaltungs-, Steuer- und Compliance-Anforderungen, mit Versicherungen sowie Vermietern
- Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law (Platform Workers)
jobs.description:
foodora is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world's pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience-fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 65+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germ... 1 Senior Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law (Platform Workers) About the opportunity
We are on the lookout for a Senior Legal Counsel, EU Employment Law to join the Legal Team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

Join the team that protects and enables Delivery Hero's growth. In the Legal Team, you'll support key initiatives by providing proactive legal guidance that aligns business goals with regulatory standards. Your work will help mitigate risks and ensure we're positioned for sustainable, long-term success-making you a key contributor to our mission of delivering amazing experiences worldwide.

As a Senior Legal Counsel, you will advise Delivery Hero on employment law challenges related to platform work across the world. Our ideal candidate is a seasoned employment lawyer with litigation experience, passionate about the gig economy, and excited to help shape the future of work.



About the opportunity
* Lead the management of platform worker and rider classification risks globally, working closely with international employment lawyers across the Group.
* Monitor and manage high-profile litigation and regulatory investigations, and develop defense strategies in collaboration with local legal counsel.
* Partner with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to deeply understand delivery operations and the tech stack, and support the development of next-generation delivery solutions.
* Support cross-functional teams in exploring new business models and strategic opportunities related to platform work.
* Track and analyze legislative and regulatory developments impacting platform work, and advise Public Policy teams at HQ and market level.
* Act as a subject-matter expert, providing guidance to senior management and stakeholders across the Group, including availability for limited international travel (up to 10%).



What you need to be successful
* Fully qualified employment lawyer in an EU jurisdiction, with extensive experience in employment law, including in a law firm environment and a strong background in litigation; prior in-house experience is a plus.
* Deep expertise in platform work and worker classification, with hands-on experience interpreting and applying the EU Platform Workers Directive and related employment legislation.
* Strong legal judgment with the ability to influence, demonstrated through advising senior stakeholders and collaborating effectively across multi-jurisdictional and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication and drafting skills, including experience in legal drafting, executive-level communication, and creating clear, compelling slide presentations.
* Collaborative and impact-driven mindset, with hands-on experience thriving in fast-paced, evolving environments and contributing beyond defined role boundaries when needed.
* Full professional proficiency in English (working language) and fluency in at least one additional European language, with willingness to be based in or relocate to one of our markets in the EU.



What's in it for you
For this full-time position (38.5 hours per week), we offer a gross annual salary starting at EUR 115.000 (all-in), depending on your qualifications and experience, plus an attractive equity package.

An attractive benefits package including regular team events, lunch vouchers, myclubs, flexible working hours and remote work.

jobs.title: Visiting Professor (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
One of the world's most international universities, a unique founding mission positions Central European University as both an acclaimed center for the study of economic, historical, social and political challenges, and a source of support for building open and democratic societies that respect human rights and human dignity. CEU is accredited in the United States and Austria, and offers English-language bachelor's, master's and doctoral programs in the social sciences, the humanities, law, environmental sciences, management and public policy. CEU enrolls more than 1,400 students from over 100 countries, with faculty from over 50 countries.

In 2019, CEU relocated from Hungary to Austria as the Hungarian government revoked its ability to issue US-accredited degrees in the country. As a result, CEU offers all of its degree programs in Vienna, Austria; and retains a non-degree, research and civic engagement presence in Budapest, Hungary, through its CEU Democracy Institute, the Institute for Advanced Study, the CEU Summer University and The Vera and Donald Blinken Open Society Archives (OSA), and its Hungarian language public educational programs and public lectures.

Full-time/Part-time: Full-time
Location: Vienna, AT, 1100
Application Deadline:  September 20th, 2026

The Department of Philosophy invites applications for a visiting teaching position for the 2027 academic year. The successful candidate will contribute to the Department's undergraduate and graduate teaching programs, offering courses in their area of specialization and participating in the intellectual life of the Department. Applicants should hold a PhD in Philosophy by the start of the appointment.



Duties and Responsibilities



Teaching Responsibilities:


* Teach three 2-credit courses each academic term at either the undergraduate or graduate level.
* Among them, teach the mandatory undergraduate course Philosophical Problems in Politics and Economics.
* The topics of the remaining elective courses are flexible, although courses with a focus on social philosophy are preferred.



Other Responsibilities:


* Participate actively in the Department's academic and administrative activities, particularly examinations and admissions procedures.
* Supervise BA and MA theses.
* Contribute to the intellectual life of the Department through collaboration with colleagues and participation in departmental events and initiatives.



Qualifications


Applicants should hold a PhD in Philosophy by the start of the appointment.



What CEU Offers


The appointment includes:


An 18-month fixed-term contract (from January 1, 2027, to June 30, 2028) at 40 hours per week, with a yearly gross salary of EUR 70,000 (paid in 14 installments, as is customary in Austria), as well as additional benefits, including meal vouchers and professional development opportunities.



How to Apply


Applicants are required to submit:


* A cover letter, including a statement on the applicant's qualifications to teach courses in areas related to social philosophy and an indication of the types of courses they would plan to offer
* A comprehensive CV, including a list of publications and the names and contact details of two potential referees
* An article-length writing sample (a paper already published or accepted for publication is preferred)
* Two course syllabi
** One on the Philosophical Problems in Economics and Politics
** The topic of the other course is optional
* The names and contact information of two reference persons submitted in the application portal. Note that references will only be contacted for shortlisted candidates.

jobs.employer: Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "Orange Truck S
jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "Orange Truck Service"  aicina darbā Transporta mehāniķi

Transporta mehāniķa galvenie darba pienākumi ietver automobīļu un citu transportlīdzekļu tehnisko apkopi, diagnostiku, remontu un mehānisko mezglu regulēšanu. Transporta mehāniķim jānodrošina transportlīdzekļu nepārtraukta un droša darbība, jākonstatē un jānovērš bojājumus, jāplāno remontdarbus, lai izvairītos no dīkstāvēm, un jāievēro darba drošības noteikumus.


Galvenie darba pienākumi: Diagnostika un pārbaude: Transportlīdzekļu tehniskā stāvokļa novērtēšana un bojājumu konstatēšana, izmantojot diagnostikas iekārtas, mērinstrumentus un datorprogrammas. Detaļu nomaiņas nepieciešamības diagnosticēšana un nepieciešamo detaļu pasūtīšana.

Profesijai specifiskie pamatuzdevumi

jobs.title: Lastbilchauffør søges til faste ture - Fredericia
jobs.description:
X max ApS søger lige nu dygtige lastbilchauffører til vores afdeling i Fredericia.

Som chauffør hos os får du en hverdag præget af faste ture med få stops. Du kender dine ruter, og vi prioriterer et roligt arbejdsmiljø uden stressende bytrafik eller konstante nye leveringsadresser. Det giver dig mulighed for at fokusere på sikker kørsel og overblik.

Du møder ind i Fredericia og kører ud på dine fastlagte ture. Arbejdstiden er fuldtid (5 dage om ugen) med ca. 10 timers effektiv arbejdstid om dagen, planlagt med fornuftige køreplaner og respekt for pauser.

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har et gyldigt CE-kørekort.

  • Har erfaring med kørsel med trækker og trailer.

  • Kan kommunikere på enten dansk eller engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt (nødvendigt for sikkerhed og kundekontakt).

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, punktlig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Sætter pris på klare rammer, faste rutiner og et velorganiseret arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • Høj løn – vi belønner din erfaring og indsats.

  • Faste ture – du ved, hvad du skal, og hvor du skal hen.

  • Få stops – ingen stressende jagt på mange små adresser.

  • Udgangspunkt fra vores depot i Fredericia.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på trivsel, godt samarbejde og ordentlige forhold.

  • Et internationalt miljø, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed.

Ansøgning

Er du den stabile og erfarne chauffør, vi mangler i teamet i Fredericia? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi ser gerne ansøgninger på både dansk og engelsk.

Send din ansøgning til: xmax-online@outlook.com Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til os på 28 19 98 18.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

X max ApS – Professionel transportløsning med personlig touch.

**************************************************************************************************************

**************************************************************************************************************

Truck Driver Wanted for Fixed Routes - Fredericia

X max ApS is currently looking for skilled truck drivers for our department in Fredericia.

As a driver with us, you will experience a workday characterized by fixed routes with few stops. You know your routes, and we prioritize a calm working environment without stressful city traffic or constantly changing delivery addresses. This allows you to focus on safe driving and maintaining an overview.

You will report to our location in Fredericia and drive your predetermined routes. This is a full-time position (5 days a week) with approximately 10 effective working hours per day, planned with sensible schedules and respect for rest breaks.

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid CE driver’s license

  • Have experience driving with a tractor and trailer

  • Can communicate in either Danish or English – both verbally and in writing (necessary for safety and customer contact)

  • Are responsible, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Appreciate clear frameworks, fixed routines, and well-organized work

We offer:

  • High salary – we reward your experience and effort

  • Fixed routes – you know what you need to do and where you need to go

  • Few stops – no stressful rush to many small addresses

  • Base location at our depot in Fredericia

  • A strong team focused on well-being, good collaboration, and proper working conditions

  • An international environment where we value diversity

Application
Are you the stable and experienced driver we are looking for in our Fredericia team? Then send your application and CV today. We welcome applications in both Danish and English.

Send your application to: xmax-online@outlook.com
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to call us at 28 19 98 18.

We look forward to hearing from you!

X max ApS – Professional transport solutions with a personal touch.

jobs.title: Tootmistööline
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: ** Töö iseloom **
* Töö toimub siseruumides elementmajade tootmises. * Töö on füüsiliselt nõudlik ning sisaldab raskemate materjalide käsitsi tõstmist ja liigutamist. * Töö eeldab head füüsilist vastupidavust ja päeva jooksul palju liikumist. * Töö toimub tootmisgraafiku järgi ning eeldab stabiilse töötempo hoidmist kogu tööpäeva jooksul. ** Peamised tööülesanded ** * Puitkarkass-elementide valmistamine tootmisjooniste ja tööjuhiste järgi. * Materjalide mõõtmine, märkimine, lõikamine ja ettevalmistamine. * Käsitööriistade, pneumaatiliste tööriistade ja tootmisseadmete ohutu kasutamine. * Elementide koostamine ja kvaliteedi kontrollimine. * Valmistoodangu pakkimine ning materjalide liigutamine. * Töökoha ja tootmisruumide korrashoid. * Muud tootmise sujuvaks toimimiseks vajalikud tööd. ** Nõuded kandidaadile ** * Aktiivsus, kohusetundlikkus, täpsus ja hea töötahe. * Valmisolek töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. * Varasem praktiline töökogemus tootmis-, ehitus- või puidutöö valdkonnas. * Tehniline taip ja oskus kasutada tavapäraseid käsitööriistu. * Oskus lugeda tööjooniseid. * Hea füüsiline vastupidavus. * Valmisolek töötada tempokas tootmiskeskkonnas, kus olulised on nii töö kvaliteet kui ka kiirus. * Usaldusväärsus, vastutustundlikkus ja regulaarne kohalolek. * Oskus järgida tööjuhiseid ja tööohutusnõudeid. Puitkarkass-elementide valmistamise kogemus on tugev eelis. Vajaduse korral pakume motiveeritud kandidaadile täiendavat väljaõpet ja juhendamist ettevõtte tootmisprotsesside omandamiseks. Oluline: ettevõttes kehtib alkoholi ja teiste joovastavate ainete suhtes nulltolerants. Tööle tuleb ilmuda õigel ajal ning täielikult töövõimelisena. Hindame kõrgelt töötahet, usaldusväärsust ja püsivat soovi panustada ettevõtte arengusse. Katseajal hinnatakse eelkõige töötahet, õppimisvõimet, töö kvaliteeti, töötempot ja usaldusväärsust. Kandideerimiseks palume saata: * CV; * lühike enesetutvustus; * soovitud brutotasu; * võimalik tööle asumise aeg.

Omalt poolt pakume: * väljaõpet ja juhendamist töökohal;
* kaasaegseid ja kvaliteetseid töövahendeid; * stabiilset aastaringset tööd; * konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt oskustele, kogemusele ja tööpanusele; * vaheldusrikkaid tööülesandeid; * sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda; * võimalust õppida uusi oskusi ning areneda tootmis- ja ehitusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Kandidaadilt ootame aktiivsust, kohusetundlikkust, täpsust, tehnilist taipu, korraarmastust ja head töötahet. Oluline on soov tööd teha, õppida ja areneda, oskus järgida juhiseid ning valmisolek meeskonnatööks ja füüsiliseks tööks.

Tule loo koos meiega kooli oma köök!

Tööülesanded: Alates uuest õppeaastast alustab ProTERA asenduspinnal oma toitlustusega ning otsime oma meeskonda
KOKKA ja KÖÖGI ABITÖÖLIST. Kui Sulle meeldib valmistada maitsvat toitu, väärtustad puhtust ja head meeskonnatööd ning soovid anda oma panuse laste igapäevasesse koolipäeva, siis ootame Sind kandideerima. KOKA peamised tööülesanded: * valmistad toite vastavalt menüüle ja retseptidele; * valmistad ette toorainet ning hoolitsed selle nõuetekohase käitlemise eest; * tagad toidu kvaliteedi ja korrektse serveerimise; * hoiad korras oma töökoha ja köögi; * järgid toiduohutuse ning hügieeninõudeid; * teed koostööd toitlustusjuhi ja ülejäänud köögimeeskonnaga. KÖÖGI ABITÖÖLUSE peamised tööülesanded: * valmistad ette toorainet; * pesed nõusid ning hoolitsed köögi puhtuse eest; * aitad toidu väljastamisel ja muudes igapäevastes köögitöödes; * võtad vastu ja paigutad kaupa; * järgid hügieeni- ja tööohutusnõudeid.

Omalt poolt pakume: * võimalust olla osa kooli täiesti uue toitlustuse käivitamisest;
* stabiilset ja tähendusrikast tööd haridusasutuses; * toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda; * väljaõpet ja sisseelamise tuge; * 35 kalendripäeva põhipuhkust.

jobs.title: Keevitaja-koostaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Seoses töömahu suurenemisega otsime enda meeskonda uusi liikmeid. Igapäevane töö on roostevabast ja värvilisest metallist toodete ning detailide valmistamine. Töö sisaldab ettevalmistust, keevitamist ja koostamist.
Tööd on erinevad, alates üksikutest detailidest ja konveierite osadest kuni suuremate konstruktsioonideni. Valmistame näiteks mahuteid ja anumaid, käiguteid ja platvorme koos piiretega, erinevaid konveierlahendusi ning toiduainetööstuse seadmete detaile. Lisaks tegeleme erinevate seadmete ja erilahendustega, kus kasutatakse ka värvilisi metalle nagu alumiinium, vask ja messing. Osa tööst tehakse kliendi jooniste alusel, kuid sageli tuleb klient meie juurde vaid idee või vajadusega. Sellisel juhul töötame lahenduse ise välja, sest meil on majas oma projekteerija, kes aitab ideest teha toimiva ja teostatava lahenduse. Vajadusel osaled ka valminud toodete paigaldamisel objektidel. Meil ei ole iga päev sama töö. Iga projekt on erinev ja nõuab mõtlemist ning oma panust. Kui sulle meeldib vaheldusrikas töö ja tahad näha oma töö tulemust päriselt valmiskujul, siis siin sul igav ei hakka.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tööaeg E-R 7.00-15.30 või 8.00-16.30
Lisa talvepuhkust 5 tööpäeva, mida saab kasutada perioodil jaanuar–aprill Tervisehüvitist kuni 400 € aastas, mida saab kasutada näiteks hambaraviks, eriarstide külastamiseks, massaažiks, sportimiseks jms Korralikke töövahendeid ja kaasaegset töökeskkonda Täiendavat väljaõpet kohapeal ning tugevat sisseelamisprogrammi Pikaajalist ja stabiilset töösuhet kiiresti arenevas ettevõttes Toetavat ja nooruslikku meeskonda, kus väärtustatakse koostööd ja head huumorit Õppimis- ja arenguvõimalusi ettevõtte sees Töötasu vastavalt oskustele ja kogemusele

Muud nõuded: Erialane kutseharidus või töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal.
Erinevate värviliste metallide( roostevaba, messing , alumiinium ja vask) keevitamise oskus TIG ja MIG meetodil. Hea tehniline taip ja jooniste lugemise oskus. Hea materjalide tundmine. Meeskonnatöö oskus ning vastutustundlik suhtumine. Ausus, täpsus, kohusetundlikkus ja lojaalsus tööandjale. EESTI KEELE oskus suhtlustasandil.

jobs.title: Süsteemiadministraator (Microsoft)
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Tahad kujundada avaliku sektori teenuste tulevikku? Liitu Rahandusministeeriumi Infotehnoloogiakeskusega süsteemiadministraatorina ning aita tagada turvalised, skaleeritavad ja kaasaegsed teenused meie partnerasutustele. Sinu peamised ülesanded saavad olema:
Microsoft 365 platvormide (Entra ID, Intune, Exchange, Teams, jne) konfigureerimine ja probleemide lahendamine; Windows serverite, MS SQL, MS AD, IIS, Exchange haldus; RmIT klientide Microsoft Azure pilveteenuste haldus ja juurutus (sh VM-d, võrguressursid, skaleerimine, automatiseerimine); süsteemide monitooring ja intsidentide käsitlemine (kaasas käiv tugi ja probleemianalüüs); uuendused ja tootestamine; dokumentatsiooni loomine ja hoidmine.

Omalt poolt pakume: Miks meiega liituda? Meil on toetav ja motiveeritud tiim, kus jagatakse teadmisi ja hoitakse tiimitunnet. Pakume paindlikku töökorraldust – töötad seal, kus oled kõige tõhusam. Sind ootab 35 päeva puhkust + 3 tervisepäeva. Kasutad Stebby spordihüvitist või tervisekindlustust – sinu valikul. Sinu panust väärtustatakse – pakume konkurentsivõimelist palka ja karjäärivõimalusi. jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

  • Act as the ultimate point of authority on Technical Claims topics, providing evidence-based advice and recommendations on case strategies, technical referrals, and other areas of relevant subject matter expertise.

Tänään tämä elävä tiilitalo toimii monipuolisena järjestö- ja kansalaistoiminnan keskuksena, jonka arvopohja nojaa lämpimään kohtaamiseen ja välittämiseen.

jobs.title: Ecosystem Sales Manager: Scale
A Book of Your Own
jobs.description:
Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.

It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.

I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.

It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.

There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips

Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.

Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?

Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?

Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.

Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.

jobs.title: This IS Your Dream Job
jobs.description:
Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday?

The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing.

Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job

The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment.

Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job

STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand

STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you.

STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement.

STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is âEnhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ.

STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree.

STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. Get involved with online forums and interest groups that will help you learn more about the latest techniques in your area of interest. As you spend more time learning and practicing, your skills will improve.

Never underestimate the value of volunteering without asking for additional compensationâ¦your boss and superiors will be impressed that you are interested enough to take on a project without asking for something in return. Showcase your best efforts by volunteering to work on projects that will give you a chance to demonstrate your expertise.

Land Mines to Avoid

Being your own worst enemy â downplaying your talents wonât get you noticed or into consideration for that great new project. Toot your own horn and let others know that you are good at xyz (in the example above, creating charts and graphs). Just as important, offer to help others with that task â soon you will become the resident expert, the one that others turn to for help and advice on this topic

Being finished with learning â remember learning doesnât stop because you have that framed diploma. Keep taking courses, attending seminars and staying in touch with others in your field so that you stay at the leading edge of knowledge and practice in your area of interest

Getting stuck in a rut â Sometimes it seems easier to lay low and just plod along. But you canât stay still â keep looking for new opportunities to apply your talents and showcase them in new and interesting ways.

Decide what you like (and what you donât), do your homework, work hard at new opportunities and advertise the resultsâbefore you know it, youâll be living your dream job.

Contributor: Julie Clarke, Vancouver Island University (www.pr.viu.ca/techcomm)

jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.



At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.



This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.



As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.



Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.



You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.



You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.



You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.



Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.



Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.



If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G15A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

jobs.title: Safariopas ja kuljettaja Kilpisjärvelle – vietä talvi Suomen upeimmissa tunturimaisemissa
jobs.description:
Haluatko viettää talven paikassa, jossa työpäivä voi alkaa moottorikelkkasafarilla, jatkua kuljetuksella Norjan vuonoille ja päättyä revontulien loisteeseen?

Kilpissafarit etsii tiimiinsä aktiivista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä safariopasta ja kuljettajaa talvikaudelle Kilpisjärvelle.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa, upeissa tunturimaisemissa ja osana pientä, ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työ on ennen kaikkea asiakaspalvelua ja opastamista. Vastaat siitä, että asiakkaamme saavat turvallisen, sujuvan ja mieleenpainuvan elämyksen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja opastaminen

- moottorikelkka-, lumikenkä- ja muiden aktiviteettien ohjaaminen

- asiakkaiden kuljettaminen yrityksen bussilla tarvittaessa

- varusteiden valmistelu ja huolto

- kalustosta huolehtiminen

- muut matkailuyrityksen päivittäiset tehtävät


Kuljetuksia on vain osa työstä – pääpaino on asiakkaiden opastamisessa ja laadukkaan elämyksen tuottamisessa.

Toivomme sinulta

- D-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa kuljettajan ammattipätevyyttä

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- iloista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä


Eduksi katsomme

- aiemman kokemuksen matkailu- tai ohjelmapalvelualalta

- ensiapukoulutuksen

- muun kielitaidon

- kokemuksen moottorikelkoista tai muista ulkoaktiviteeteista


Vaikka et täyttäisi jokaista kohtaa, kannustamme silti hakemaan, jos uskot olevasi oikea henkilö tehtävään.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Palkka 19 €/h

- Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työn

- Kattavan perehdytyksen

- Hyvät työvälineet ja laadukkaan kaluston

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi matkailualalla

- Pienen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- Edullisen, kalustetun majoituksen Kilpisjärvellä


Miksi Kilpisjärvi?

Kilpisjärvi on yksi Suomen ainutlaatuisimmista matkailukohteista. Työpäivien aikana pääset liikkumaan tuntureilla, työskentelemään kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa ja kokemaan arktisen luonnon parhaimmillaan.

Vapaa-ajalla käytössäsi ovat:

- upeat vaellusreitit

- laskettelu ja maastohiihto

- kalastus

- Norjan vuonot vain noin 50 kilometrin päässä

- revontulet ja tunturiluonto aivan kotiovella


Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt ihmisten parissa, pidät vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja haluat viettää talven paikassa, josta moni tulee vain haaveilemaan.

Työsuhde

- Talvikausi 2026–2027

- Työsuhde tai halutessasi myös yrittäjäsopimus

- Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä sopisit osaksi Kilpissafareiden tiimiä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Erfaren chefkonsulent til ledelses- og organisationsudvikling i KL
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke ledelses- og organisationsudviklingen i KL, og til at sikre den fortsatte udvikling af KL som en stærk og indflydelsesrig interesseorganisation? Vi leder efter en fagligt stærk kollega, der kan være med til at drive og understøtte strategiske HR-initiativer inden for organisations-, kompetence- og ledelsesudvikling.

KL er en kompleks politisk organisation, hvor vi arbejder for demokratiet og for at sikre kommunernes fælles interesser. I Organisationsudvikling & HR udvikler og driver vi aktiviteter, der skal styrke KL's potentiale og muligheder for at varetage kommunernes interesser.

Vi står som kontor midt i maskinrummet i en spændende og dynamisk organisation, hvor vi har tæt kontakt til chefer, medarbejdere og direktion samt til vores medlemmer - de danske kommuner. Vi sætter barren højt og arbejder altid for at gøre tingene endnu bedre.

Din hverdag i KL

Du bliver en del af et kontor med en bred opgaveportefølje og får en central rolle i udviklingen og gennemførelsen af KL's interne udviklingsaktiviteter.

Dine opgaver vil især ligge inden for følgende områder, men den konkrete opgavefordeling sker i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer:
  • Organisationsudvikling: Understøtte organisatoriske forandringer, tværgående samarbejder og vidensdeling samt udvikle og facilitere kontorseminarer.
  • Strategiske HR-processer: Drive og udvikle processer inden for lokalløn og overenskomster, samt samarbejde med tillids- og arbejdsmiljørepræsentanter.
  • Ledelsesudvikling: Udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre sammenhængende ledelsesudviklingsforløb.
  • Ledelsessparring: Sparring med kontorchefer om udviklingen af kontorets ressourcer, fx i forhold til bl.a. samarbejde, kompetencer, rekruttering og løn, i samarbejde med kollegaerne i kontoret.
  • Kompetenceudvikling: Udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre kompetenceudviklingstilbud særligt målrettet KL og de kompetencer, som er særligt relevante for KL's kerneopgave, fx interessevaretagelse.

I Organisationsudvikling & HR løser vi opgaver i tæt samarbejde på tværs af kontoret. Du får derfor en hverdag, hvor du både har ansvar for egne opgaver og bidrager til fælles indsatser sammen med kollegaerne. Afhængigt af dine erfaringer og interesser kan du også komme til at arbejde med øvrige HR-områder, fx arbejdsmiljø eller forhandling af løn og overenskomster.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse, gerne suppleret med efteruddannelse inden for fx ledelse eller organisationspsykologi. Du har formentlig flere års relevant erfaring med at drive ledelses- og organisationsudvikling fx fra en kommune, centraladministrationen eller en interesseorganisation.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med at udvikle og implementere ledelses- og organisationsudviklingen fra spæd idé til forankring i praksis.
  • Kan skabe fremdrift i komplekse opgaver og processer, også når målet endnu ikke er fuldt defineret, og har procestålmodighed til at fastholde retning og momentum
  • Har erfaring med rådgivning og sparring med chefer
  • Er en stærk facilitator, der er i stand til at skabe tryghed, energi og retning
  • Har kendskab til og erfaring med arbejdet i en politisk ledet organisation
  • Kan indsamle og analysere både kvalitative og kvantitative data og oversætte dem til udviklingstiltag og anbefalinger
  • Har stærke samarbejdsevner og trives med at opbygge relationer til særligt kontorchefer (personaleledere), samt direktion og øvrige kollegaer på tværs af huset
  • Har erfaring med, eller lyst til at udvikle din erfaring med, at anvende testværktøjer som led i udvikling og rekruttering
  • Er nysgerrig på at forstå, hvordan KL bedst udvikler sig for at styrke kommuner, kommunalpolitik og lokalt demokrati

Vi tilbyder dig

I KL bliver du en del af en organisation med ca. 400 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at styrke kommunernes interesser. Du får en central rolle i at drive og videreudvikle aktiviteter og initiativer målrettet KL som organisation, og du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med stort ansvar, gode udviklingsmuligheder og opgaver med både politisk og strategisk betydning.

Organisationsudvikling & HR er et kontor med 15 engagerede kollegaer med et stærkt tværgående samarbejde. Kontoret arbejder med en bred opgaveportefølje, der blandt andet omfatter politisk organisering, tværgående sekretariatsopgaver, organisationsudvikling, HR, løn- og personaleadministration samt relationer til KL's tilknyttede virksomheder.

Hos os får du en hverdag med afveksling, samarbejde og mulighed for at følge opgaver fra idé til gennemførelse i en organisation med høj faglighed, stærkt kollegaskab og gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling. Du får mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på en kompleks organisation, hvor processerne sjældent er lineære. Nogle gange er der kort fra tanke til handling, mens andre processer kan strække sig og har flere tilbageløb.

Det praktiske

Send os din ansøgning senest den 16. august 2026. Vi håber at kunne byde dig velkommen den 1. oktober 2026.

Vi holder første samtale den 21. august, formentlig som en kortere screeningssnak. Herefter følger et testforløb, samt en anden samtale, som er planlagt til den 27. august.

Der kan blive gennemført både test og case i forbindelse med 2. samtalerunde, ligesom der forud for ansættelsen indhentes referencer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger den relevante overenskomst i KL med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer.

Er du nysgerrig på at høre mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Julie Appelt Honoré på telefonnummer 61669927.

KL er interesse- og medlemsorganisation for de 98 kommunalbestyrelser i Danmark. KL bidrager til at udvikle og fastholde et stærkt lokalt demokrati. KL varetager kommunernes fælles interesser og er kommunernes samlede forhandlingsorganisation, videnscenter og forum for fælles initiativer og beslutninger.

KL ser forskellighed i medarbejdersammensætningen og i ledelsen som en af vores styrker og opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Kig forbi vores KL Karriereunivers og lær mere om os som arbejdsplads og medarbejdere. https://www.kl.dk/karriereunivers/forside

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

jobs.title: Postdoc in BioPhysics
jobs.description:
Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms. However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

This application is posted with a corresponding PhD position and only one of the positions will be filled. We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with a preference for some knowledge about programming.

The postdoc’s duties will include research within biophysics as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

Further information on the Department is linked at the NBI website. Inquiries about the position can be made to Kristian Thijssen, Kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk.

Terms of employment
The two-year position is open from 1 Nov 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors of Molecular Imaging
jobs.description:
We are looking for three highly motivated and dynamic assistant professors who can lead molecular imaging projects as part of a 3-year position to commence between November 2026 and February 2027.

Our research
Cluster for Molecular Imaging was established in 2004 by Professor Andreas Kjær to pursue translational molecular imaging research. The research is driven by unmet medical needs and includes all steps from molecule identification to evaluation in patients with a strong focus on the transfer of new methods into clinical practice. The research covers several disease areas including oncology, immune-oncology, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammatory diseases. The group has so far translated 5 PET tracers into the clinic.

Cluster for Molecular Imaging has access to all necessary facilities for molecular imaging, including preclinical and clinical imaging facilities, cyclotrons, and radiochemistry as well as laboratories for molecular biology, flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, and a cell laboratory.

The group currently consists of 40 researchers covering a wide range of disciplines, including medicine, pharmacy, chemistry, engineering, biology, molecular biology, and physics.

Your job
You will join a multidisciplinary research team working on translational molecular imaging.

You are expected to design, execute and analyse high impact translational research related to molecular imaging. The exact project(s) to be conducted depends on the candidate’s background and experiences.

The assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination duties
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
  • Supporting fundraising activities
Profile
Six overall criteria apply for assistant professor appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit.

Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience:

Essential experience and skills:

  • You have a PhD in Molecular Imaging or an adjacent field
  • You have an active interest in translational medical research and innovation
  • You have documented pre- and postgraduate teaching experience
  • Proficient communication skills and ability to work in teams
  • Strong publication record corresponding to your career stage
  • Excellent English skills written and spoken
Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience within areas such as oncology, immunology, infectious diseases or related biomedical fields
  • Experience working across academic, clinical, and/or industry settings
  • Interest in innovation, translational science, or implementation of research into practice
Place of employment
The place of employment is at the Department of Biomedical Sciences, Panum Institute, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment.

Terms of employment
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week for 1 position, and 18,5 hours for 2 positions.

The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is in Ot

Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 40,000 DKK (November 2025 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund.

Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions if they have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information please contact Daniel Murray, daniel.murray@sund.ku.dk.

Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

Application procedure
Your application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (Max. one page)
  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position
  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do
  4. List of publications
  5. Teaching portfolio (If applicable)
Deadline for applications is 16 August 2026, 23.59 (CEST)

We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

The further process
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Interviews are expected to be held in week 37-38.



The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Autonasentaja, Paimio
jobs.description:
**Autonasentaja Paimioon**

Etsitkö uutta suuntaa urallesi vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa työsuhteessa? StaffMill Oy (https://www.staffmill.fi/) etsii nyt osaavaa autonasentajaa Paimioon. Tässä tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi monipuolisesti ja kehittymään autoalan mukana.

**Mitä teet arjessa?**

Työpäiväsi koostuvat kaikista henkilöautojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä. Pääset tekemään mekaanista korjausta ja huoltoa sekä hyödyntämään ajoneuvodiagnostiikkaa, vikakoodien lukua sekä mittaustekniikkaa ja testauslaitteita. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden tiimin jäsenten kanssa ja kohtaat asiakkaita arjessa.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta autojen korjaamisesta

- B-ajokorttia

- Suomen kielen taitoa


**Tehtävässä menestymistä tukevat:**

- Mekaaninen korjaus- ja huolto-osaaminen

- Ajoneuvodiagnostiikan ja vikakoodien luvun hallinta

- Mittaustekniikan ja testauslaitteiden käyttöosaaminen

- Asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaidot

- Sopeutumiskyky ja halu oppia uutta teknologian kehittyessä

- Tiimityöskentely- ja yhteistyötaidot


**Käytännön tiedot**

- **Sijainti**: Paimio

- **Työsuhteen tyyppi**: Vakituinen

- **Työaika**: Kokoaikainen


Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisesta linkistä, käsittelemme hakemukset heti niiden saavuttua.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Heikki, puh. 044 323 7001 (tavoitettavissa arkisin klo 8-16).

Tarjoamme sinulle luotettavan työnantajan, selkeän yhteydenpidon sekä nopean puhelintuen työ- ja terveystilanteissa.

jobs.title: Klinikbiträde
jobs.description:
Vi på MarieVet söker klinikbiträde/djurvårdare till vår klinik i Mariehamn med ca 80% anställning, motsvarande ca 30h/vecka.

Vår verksamhet består idag av två veterinärer, tre djursjukvårdare och två klinikbiträden. Vi har en välutrustad klinik med labb, röntgen, ultraljud, operationsavdelning samt tandsal med tandröntgen. Våra patienter är främst hundar och katter, men vi tar även emot gnagare och exotics. Vi brinner för att erbjuda modern, evidensbaserad vård samt att ha personlig kontakt med våra kunder.

Som klinikbiträde hos oss är dina främsta uppgifter att bemanna receptionen, städa efter patienter, instrumentvård, hjälpande hand med patienterna som t.ex. blodprovstagning och kloklippning.

Vi söker dig som är utbildad djurvårdare, har erfarenhet av att arbeta som klinikbiträde på smådjursklinik eller har annan motsvarande arbetserfarenhet. Du ska tycka om att jobba i team och vara bekväm med kundkontakt då receptionen är vårt ansikte utåt. Som person önskar vi att du är stresstålig, noggrann och organiserad. Vi ser gärna att du är ambitiös och tycker om att utvecklas i din roll.

Arbetstiden är förlagd mellan våra öppettider som är 08-18 måndagar-torsdagar. Övriga tider kan förekomma enligt överenskommelse.

Lön enligt Erto:s rekommendationer för veterinärkliniker.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tillträde kan ske innan utsatt datum.
